regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad but non-directional 9/16-eligible leadership state with Oil & Gas Producers leading (crowded, mixed durability) and Base Metals & Copper challenging. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown control), which does help on this market history, so trend-following discipline applies — but cross-sectional rank carries no return-forecast edge and rotation timing is display-only.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Oil & Gas Producers to Base Metals & Copper: margin is narrowing (0.223) and copper is non-crowded. What would retire the watch for now: if XEG.TO re-extends its margin over XBM.TO by 10% relative to benchmark, the oil lead remains intact and this handoff hypothesis is shelved.

evidence: trend gate validated_risk_control on this market (gate_helps true)
broad eligible breadth 0.56 supports a trend regime rather than a single narrative blow-off

theses.thesis: Challenger with trend eligibility and non-crowded positioning; momentum rank is only a focus lens but the trend gate permits a follow-through posture if copper holds trend. Mean-revert Hurst tag argues against extrapolating a sharp multi-leg rally.
evidence: rank 2 of 16, score 1.545, margin to leader only 0.223
theses.dissent: Hurst 'mean-revert' suggests any sharp recent move is likely to retrace; no return-forecast edge in the rank.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its own 50-day average on the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Not trend-eligible (eligible false) under the ONLY validated edge — the absolute-trend gate. The gate's purpose is shake-out avoidance, so a non-eligible low-momentum theme is excluded regardless of valuation appeal.
evidence: trend gate validated risk-control leg (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: Defensive yield themes can rally when macro risk spikes, and trend-gate exclusion has no mean-return forecast (validation is vol/drawdown only).
